    Args:
        args (List[str]): List of command-line arguments.

    Returns:
        Tuple[Optional[Dict[str, str]], Optional[str]]: Parsed proxy options and key.
    """

        'proxy_protocol': 'https',
        'proxy_port': 80,
        'proxy_host': None
